title: Machine Learning & NLP Engineer (LLMs / RAG)
description: Looking for an innovative Machine Learning & NLP Engineer to build cutting-edge Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and fine-tune transformer models. You will implement dense semantic search with vector databases (such as ChromaDB), evaluate LLM outputs, and deploy high-speed inference endpoints using Python, PyTorch, and FastAPI. Experience with LangChain, embedding models, and vector search is strongly preferred.
